g.text: LanguageDef Anatomy — Where Rust Actually Leaks In
Five specification fields carry Rust — measured, not asserted.
Reproduce from the mettail-rust worktree root with
field declarations. Five are specification content
couplings escape any type predicate and are listed separately in §I.4:
The shared specification datatype — here, the root record
Carries a Rust type or Rust code
Declarative itself, but composes a Rust-bearing member
